ctx.x: where Richard Wagner used to do that. You know, he would write a viola part or a violin part, to go, keep going down, and the guy, you know, just runs right off the register. Because if you go down just to the bottom there's a tendency to psychologically stop, you know, but he just wanted him to go and play off the horn, really loud -- off the violin, really loud. And it's a psychological thing, just read it straight on through, you know? And I learned that. I learned a lot of things from studying like that and a…
Do you think Duke did things like that psychologically, writing the music in a way that would affect the players?
